#if !defined(KJ_ASSERT_ARRAYPTR_COUNTERS)
#define KJ_ASSERT_ARRAYPTR_COUNTERS 0

This mirrors `KJ_ASSERT_PTR_COUNTERS` in `kj/memory.h:27`, which defaults to `KJ_DEBUG_MEMORY` instead.
